actors: Indonesian technical delegation (Department of Mining / Pertamina)
reasoning: A protest at South Vietnam's overlapping concession decree and a restatement of Indonesia's Natuna-based shelf line is a verbal assertion; declarative. The talks themselves were cooperative, and the protest is known only from 1974 US embassy reporting (a Mining Ministry letter of 18 April 1974 quoted in translation), so a coder should weigh it as a diplomatic protest delivered in a negotiating setting.

location_name: Indonesian continental shelf (incl. north of the Natuna Islands)
summary: Indonesia enacted Law No. 1 of 1973 on the Indonesian Continental Shelf, signed by President Soeharto on 6 January 1973, which gave statutory form to the 17 February 1969 shelf announcement and vested full control and exclusive rights over the natural resources of the Indonesian continental shelf in the State; the shelf it covers includes the seabed north of the Natuna Islands that South Vietnam also claimed.
reasoning: Unilateral legislation asserting sovereign rights over the continental shelf is a legal assertion; declarative. It is archipelago-wide rather than Natuna-specific, hence dyad IA; its SCS relevance is the overlap with South Vietnam's 1971 shelf claim north of Natuna.
